text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука has received a letter
from a fan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A letter? Oh, it's from a young
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's thanks to my fans' support that
I'm able
to enter certain races.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Still, it does feel a little strange.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I'm often complimented on my racing...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
But I don't understand how people can
just watch
on without feeling tempted to
run themselves.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list:
It's because watching you run is satisfying
enough.

text_block_list.text: Interesting... So, that's how they feel.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Then... I suppose I'll have to make sure I
keep
running the way I do.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It seems Сайленс Судзука has come to
better
understand the feelings of her
supporters.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
